text:
Emily Tran: Quick ask — need to lock a 60m design review for the new API routing + SDK auth + Console UX changes. Prefer next Tue/Wed. Agenda: preread checklist, API contract walk, SDK auth flow, console mockups, rollout plan. PR/Mocks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/456 and Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/new-console. Who must be on this?

Raj Patel: Tue/Wed works for me. Can we keep it short 45m? Core reviewers: Raj, Maria, Alex, Toni.

Maria Gomez: Wed afternoon is best. pls share preread checklist — I'll do a pass.

Jake Lee: I'm OOO Wed morning, afternoon ok. Can we add perf targets and canary rollout section?

Emily Tran: yes — adding perf + canary. Quick preread checklist:
```
- Read RFC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/456
- Run local sample with new SDK flag (instructions in PR)
- Review Console mockups (Figma link above)
- Confirm auth edge cases doc (see /docs/auth-edge-cases.md)
- Add questions to this thread with the prefix Q:
```

Alex Chen: linking small smoke script to test auth: `scripts/smoke-auth.sh` — will add to PR.

Toni Park: suggest a third slot Thurs in case we need build time. Also propose to tag eng-sre and product.

calendar-bot: Holding Wed 2025-03-12 14:00-15:00 PT tentatively — accept/decline via calendar.

Emily Tran: Thanks. Can reviewers add thumbs if they can make it and add any preread blockers. If we hit <=3 confirmed, we'll shorten to 45m. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: :thumbsup: added comments to PR about API error model.

Maria Gomez: reviewed mocks, a11y comment on keyboard nav — leaving note in Figma.

Jake Lee: added perf target numbers in doc, flagged a tokenization edge case.

Alex Chen: will run smoke test and report by EOD Monday.

Toni Park: tagging eng-sre and product — @eng-sre @product-team please chime in if you'd like a short brief.
